reasoning_content:
The traefik API is at port 8080 internal. The backend-dev router forwards to host.docker.internal:3030. The main app route on localhost:3000 goes to backend via traefik. Let me check with the API on traefik's port. Actually the port 3000 is traefik's entrypoint. The api.insecure: true serves the API on the traefik entrypoint :8080, not :3000. Let me curl inside the container.

Actually, more important: `Host: auth.localhost` returns 404 (traefik no route). Let me check the traefik API from within container on 8080.

action.command: docker exec workspace-reverse-proxy-1 wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/api/http/routers 2>/dev/null | head -c 2000; echo; echo "=== raw ==="; docker exec workspace-reverse-proxy-1 wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/api/rawdata 2>/dev/null | head -c 1500
